name: claude-agent-fleet
description: Per-window controller that detects Claude usage limits, waits for the 5-hour reset, and auto-continues the agent — while keeping the chat fully interactive.

agentFleet.enabledByDefault.description: Whether auto-continue is enabled when the window opens.

agentFleet.label.description: Optional friendly name for this window in the dashboard (defaults to the workspace folder name).

agentFleet.orchestrator.url.description: Base URL of the orchestrator. Host windows use 127.0.0.1; WSL2/Hyper-V windows use the Windows host IP.

agentFleet.orchestrator.intervalMs.description: Heartbeat interval to the orchestrator, in milliseconds.

agentFleet.usage.transcriptDir.description: Override for the Claude transcript directory. Empty uses <home>/.claude/projects.

agentFleet.usage.limitPattern.description: Case-insensitive regex that marks a transcript line as a usage-limit signal. Tune against a real limit line (visible in the dashboard event log).

agentFleet.continue.text.description: Text sent to the agent to resume after the reset.

agentFleet.continue.commandIds.description: VS Code command ids to try first for continuation (used if/when Claude Code exposes one).

agentFleet.continue.terminalPattern.description: Case-insensitive regex matching the name of an integrated terminal running the Claude CLI (for terminal-mode continuation).

agentFleet.continue.bufferSeconds.description: Seconds to wait past the detected reset time before continuing.

agentFleet.continue.minIntervalSeconds.description: Minimum seconds between two automatic continuations (dedupe guard).

agentFleet.continue.idleGuardSeconds.description: Do not auto-continue if there was transcript activity within this many seconds (avoids interrupting active work).
